pages.name: How to Use
pages.html:
This system plays Spacer in Foundry VTT with as much of the rules automated as possible. It works for a group with a referee and for solo play. This page is not from the book.

Make a character

  1. In the Actors sidebar, click Create Spacer. Or open any character sheet and click Create character.
  2. The wizard rolls the characteristics, then runs each career term: enlistment or draft, skills, survival, events, promotion, aging, and reenlistment. You choose where the book gives a choice.
  3. Click Fast to finish the rest with sensible choices, or Undo to take back the last step.
  4. Click Save to character. The wizard writes the characteristics, skills, cash, benefits, and the full lifepath log (Career tab).

Roll

  • Click a characteristic or a skill on the sheet, or click Task roll. A task is 2D + characteristic DM + skill rank; 8+ succeeds. The chat card shows the effect and absolute successes and failures.
  • Target a token and click Attack on a weapon. The dialog fills in the target's armour, range band, cover, and position. The chat card has an Apply damage button that applies damage to END first, then STR and DEX, and sets the wounded, unconscious, or dead status.
  • Set position, cover, evading, and overwatch on the Combat tab. Sprint and melee uses reset when the combat ends.

Ships and vehicles

  • Drag a sample ship from Sample Starships or a vehicle from Vehicles into the world. Drop characters on the crew roster.
  • The ship sheet fires weapons, rolls hit locations, steps drives down on damage, jumps (fuel and one week), and pays the monthly costs. Construction builds a new ship step by step.

Solo play and referee tools

Open the Spacer Toolkit from the Actors or Journal sidebar, or from the Spacer Macros compendium. It has the campaign clock and one button per procedure: worlds and subsectors, patrons and jobs, NPCs, rumours, starport, settlement, space, and planetside encounters, weather, survival, alien animals, trade, and a yes/no oracle (the oracle is not from the book).

A solo loop: generate a subsector, set the current world, generate a patron and job, advance the clock, roll encounters on the way, and ask the oracle when the rules do not say what happens.

Compendiums

  • Spacer Rules: the full text of the book, one entry per chapter.
  • Spacer Tables: every rollable table of the book. For D66 tables with a DM, add the DM to the tens die.
  • Items: skills, weapons, armour, equipment, psionic talents, drugs, ship and vehicle weapons. Drag them onto a sheet.
